prompt: Hattie races Dan around the block
title: Block Race
irony: Dan runs to beat Hattie but wins only when he slows down to finish beside her.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Chalk start line shines on the sunny street as Hattie hops beside Teddy.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Hattie challenges speedy Dad to race round the block while Dan jogs shouting one more lap.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Knox dares them to the big oak and back as Frankie waves her flag from the porch.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The street chants the block race chant as Hattie and Dan toe the chalk line.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Hattie bolts too fast and wobbles at the corner while Dan sprints ahead shouting faster.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Hattie huffs under the oak as Dan overshoots the line and Teddy lifts two juice cups.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: Neighbours chant the block race chant again as the runners loop past the porch.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Dan sees tiny Hattie panting far behind and hears his own pushy shout sting.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Dan turns back with Teddy's map and offers his steady pace to match brave Hattie home.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Hattie and Dan stride side by side as Dan sings slowing down wins the smile.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: The chant fades at the chalk line as Hattie knots Dan's shoe and they stroll home.
